title: 5 AI Agents Every Founder Needs
topic: Five Claude agents (Projects + connectors) that run a founder's week — Level 5 of the levels post, in practice
notes: Own version of the agent-recipes reference format. All workflows are honest 'draft, never send' patterns. Template: agent-recipes (Family A light).

slides.title: An agent = Claude + one job + your tools
slides.body: Give Claude a role, a few rules, and access to the tools you already use. Save it once as a Project — it shows up every day after that.

slides.title: Lead Concierge
slides.body: Watches inbound — email and WhatsApp — drafts replies in your voice, and offers call slots before the lead goes cold.

rows.t: a new lead lands in email or WhatsApp
draft a reply in my tone

slides.try: Draft replies to every unanswered lead and offer two slots each.

slides.title: Competitor Radar
slides.body: Checks your competitors every Monday — pricing, changelogs, launches — and writes what changed and what to do about it.

rows.t: write what changed and why it matters
brief in Notion before your standup

slides.try: Track [3 competitors]: pricing, features, launches. Monday brief.

slides.title: Content Engine
slides.body: Turns one build log into a content pack — carousel outline, thread and hooks — from your real work, in your voice.
slides.try: Turn this build log into a carousel outline, a thread and 3 hooks.

slides.title: Numbers Analyst
slides.body: Reads the week's numbers, charts the trend, flags anything weird — and explains it in plain English, not spreadsheet English.

rows.t: pull the week: revenue, churn, refunds

slides.try: Summarise this week's numbers in 3 lines. Flag anything weird.

slides.title: Meeting Closer
slides.body: Turns raw call notes into tasks with owners and deadlines — and a recap that goes out in minutes, not days.
slides.try: From these notes: tasks with owners, plus a recap email draft.

slides.note: The Rules line is the whole game. Agents draft, you send — that one rule keeps five agents safe to run.

slides.title: Connect once, runs forever
slides.body: Link your tools once in Settings → Connectors, save each agent as a Project. From then on it's one message — or a schedule.
